en.headline: Isaac Chong Wai’s first solo live-art show at Tai Kwun ends today
en.dek: The Berlin-based Hong Kong artist’s exhibition of conceptual performances exploring collective memory and vulnerability closes on Sunday after a run at Tai Kwun Contemporary.
body: Berlin-based Hong Kong artist Isaac Chong Wai’s first solo live-art exhibition in the city concludes today at Tai Kwun Contemporary. The free show has featured live-action installations, durational performances and synchronised movements by local performers.

Chong uses the human body as a medium to examine collective memory, historical power dynamics and vulnerability. The exhibition, titled An Intimate Surrender, has invited audiences into an immersive dialogue about empathy, resistance and human connection.
Tai Kwun Contemporary is located at 10 Hollywood Road in Central. Performance schedules have varied; visitors are advised to check the venue for any final timings on the closing day.

zh.headline: 張子謙首個本地現場藝術個展大館今日結束
zh.dek: 駐柏林香港藝術家張子謙於大館當代美術館的概念表演展今日閉幕，探討集體記憶與脆弱性。
body: 駐柏林香港藝術家張子謙在本地首個現場藝術個展於大館當代美術館今日結束。免費展覽包括現場裝置、持續表演及本地表演者同步動作。
張子謙以人體為媒介，探討集體記憶、歷史權力動態及脆弱性。名為《An Intimate Surrender》的展覽邀請觀眾進入關於同理心、抵抗與人際連結的沉浸式對話。
大館當代美術館位於中環荷李活道10號。表演時間不一，閉幕當日訪客宜查詢場地最新安排。
